The Problem

If You're Not on Page One of Google, You Don't Exist

Fewer than 1% of searchers click to page two of Google results. When a homeowner searches "HVAC repair [your city]" or "plumber near me," the contractors on page one split the overwhelming majority of that traffic. The ones on page two — or not ranked at all — get nothing, regardless of how good their work is.

Most contractors rely entirely on word of mouth and referrals. That works until it doesn't — until a slow season hits, a key referral source moves away, or a competitor with a strong online presence starts eating into your market. SEO is the infrastructure that keeps leads coming in even when your network goes quiet.

We start with data: a keyword report that shows you exactly which terms your target customers are searching, which competitors rank for them, and what it will take to break into the top positions. From that foundation, we build a content and optimization roadmap to systematically move you up the results page — and keep you there.

What You Get

Real Data. Real Rankings. Real Leads.

Keyword Report

We research exactly what your customers are typing into Google — by trade, by service, by city and suburb — and deliver a prioritized list of the terms most likely to generate qualified calls and leads.

Competitor Research

We analyze who ranks above you, what content they have that you don't, where they get their backlinks from, and what gaps exist in the market you can exploit to take rankings faster than starting from scratch.

Content Optimization Roadmap

You get a prioritized action plan — which pages to update, which new pages to create, which local signals to add — with estimated impact for each item so you can execute in order of highest return.
